ota.summary: Innovo RedBox Fury Garage 2026.09.22.03 - first build of the forked Garage variant. Pre-motion warning is now a per-door Warning Time plus a Pre-Motion Warning binary sensor for Home Assistant to drive a lamp or Zigbee siren; the device makes no sound itself. Door entity naming unified (Door 1-4 everywhere, no zero padding). Door 3 default colour green, cycle time default 2s, new Restore Default Settings button.
